textrank_summary.summary: The core of the Transformer is the self-attention mechanism that relates different positions of a single sequence in order to compute a representation of the sequence. In our model, we employ multi-head attention to allow the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions. Multi-head attention consists of several attention layers running in parallel, which allows the model to attend to information from different representation subspaces.

baseline_summaries.lead_k_summary: Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of compelling sequence modeling and transduction models in various tasks. In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output. The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.

review_cues: Extractive Faithfulness: TextRank extracts verbatim sentences directly from source text (0% hallucination risk).
Graph Centrality: Vertex importance is determined via PageRank (d=0.85, max_iter=100) over TF-IDF cosine similarities.
Chronological Ordering: Extracted sentences are strictly restored to their original document sequence.
Scanned PDF Limitation: Low-text heuristic (< 100 chars/page) flags image-only PDFs where embedded text is minimal.
Lexical Search Boundary: Passage retrieval uses lexical TF-IDF matching and does not perform neural semantic re-ranking.
Privacy by Default: Sensitive personal identifiers, emails, and credentials are automatically masked.
